actions.name: Use
actions.area: all creatures within a 20-ft.-burst, centered on target creature.

description.summary: Target’s bones explode in the body
description.value: Target’s bones explode in the body. If the target fails a Fortitude saving throw, it receives 1d6 non-elemental damage per caster level (maximum 15d6), if the target would be put into negative hit points their body explodes and deals half as much damage to all creatures within a 20 feet radius (Reflex save halves). If the Fortitude saving throw is successful, the target receives 1d4 non-elemental damage per caster level (maximum 15d4) and does not explode if they are put into negative hit points.
